content: Model weight quantization techniques BIBREF22, BIBREF23, BIBREF24, BIBREF25 focus on mapping model weights to lower-precision integers and floating-point numbers. These can be especially effective with hardware supporting efficient low-precision calculations. More recently, BIBREF26 apply quantization to BERT-based transformer models.
